scenario: Disambiguation per LGRA.15.18 — context-sensitive constructs (uppercase in pattern vs expression, dotted paths in patterns vs services vs slot access) are made explicit. Pin verifies a TYPE_NAME-led pattern coexists with a TYPE_NAME-led service path in the same rule (`Trig` pattern + `svc.method` call) without grammar collision. `x` is declared `Int`, the kind of the `t.v` it is given: a mismatched builtin kwarg is a refusal ([LADP.8.5.4]), which is not what this vector is about.
rules_ds:
service svc.method:
    kwarg x: Int
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.method x: t.v nocooldown
